questions.query: I consent to participate in this control group post-experiment reflection survey
questions.text:
Research Study Consent - Control Group Survey

Study Title: Resource Allocation and Child Development Study - Control Group

Purpose: You have been randomly assigned to the control group. This post-experiment survey collects your reflections and feedback about your experience in the resource allocation experiment.

What you will do: Reflect on your experience with the investment decision scenarios, describe your strategy, and provide feedback about the experiment design. This should take approximately 10-15 minutes.

Control Group Procedures: As part of the control group, your responses will be compared with the treatment group to assess the impact of different experimental conditions.

Risks and Benefits: There are minimal risks. You may find some questions require careful reflection about your decision-making process. Your feedback will help improve future research.

Confidentiality: Your responses will be kept strictly confidential and used only for research purposes. Group assignment and responses will be anonymized.

Voluntary Participation: Participation is voluntary. You may withdraw at any time without affecting your participation in other parts of the study.

Contact: If you have questions about this research or your rights as a participant, please contact the research team.
Thank you for completing the investment scenarios involving {child1name} and {child2name}. This final survey asks about your experience and reflections on the experiment.

In the scenarios, you made decisions about allocating lessons between {child1name} (ability: {child1ability}, attends {child1school}) and {child2name} (ability: {child2ability}, attends {child2school}).

questions.query: How difficult did you find the investment decision-making scenarios involving {child1name} and {child2name}?
Describe the strategy or approach you used when making investment decisions between {child1name} and {child2name} in the scenarios.
Which factors did you consider most when allocating lessons between {child1name} (ability: {child1ability}) and {child2name} (ability: {child2ability})? (Select all that apply)
Did the fact that {child1name} attends {child1school} and {child2name} attends {child2school} influence your investment decisions?
How did the ability difference between your children affect your decisions?
prefixes: How much the {child1ability} vs {child2ability} gap mattered to you

questions.query: Do you feel your decisions were consistent across the different scenarios involving {child1name} and {child2name}?
How similar were these experimental decisions to real-world decisions you make about {child1name} and {child2name}?
Did participating in this experiment make you think differently about how you allocate resources between {child1name} and {child2name}? Please explain.
Do you have any feedback about the experiment design, interface, or instructions? (Note: This was {sessionType} group experiment for participant {participant} with enumerator {enumerator})
Is there anything else you would like to share about your experience or thoughts related to this study involving {child1name} and {child2name}?
